title: Chapter 301
text:
In the foresight of Destiny's Child, there were no details of whether anyone survived. Han Xiao's original plan was to be the first to arrive at the crash site and steal the communicator. This thing was the key to leaving the planet, not the spaceship.

However, the communicator was in the hands of the investigator, so his original plan was not going to work. He had to think of a way to deal with the investigator.

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Rob or trick?

Seeing that Han Xiao did not respond, Kerlodd frowned and said, "I'm asking you a question. Answer me."

"You're a guest from Godora?" Han Xiaoxin thought for a while and slowly approached Kerlodd.

"The civilization of this planet is requesting help. I'm an investigator who was invited here. Who are you?"

Han Xiao approached within ten meters and said, "I'm an emissary from Blue Star. I'm here to welcome you."

"Very good. Bring me to see the highest leader of your civilization immediately!"

Kerlodd was overjoyed. He thought for a while and suddenly said, "Wait for a while. I need to inform my civilization to send someone to pick me up."

"No problem. Waiting is what I should do."

Kerlodd was satisfied with the treatment that Blue Star gave him, and he was even more satisfied with the attitude of the 'emissary'.

Just as he was about to activate the communicator, the moment he lowered his head, Han Xiao suddenly moved!

The 'Bat Wing' aircraft was activated instantly. Han Xiao was like a poisonous snake, kicking Kerlodd away and snatching the communicator in the blink of an eye.

Bang!

The kick was so powerful that Kerlodd flew away and broke four or five trees.

Han Xiao put away the communicator and made up his mind. He decided to snatch the communicator first and take the initiative.

There was no way he could stop Kerlodd from contacting the Six Nations. That way, he would be exposed. More importantly, once Kerlodd got in touch with the Six Nations, there would be no room for him to interfere. He would have to take the opportunity to steal it.

Actually, there was another way. He could pretend that he was a person from an advanced civilization in Blue Star and ask to borrow the communicator. The best result would be that Godora was willing to help, but the possibility was low.

There was a higher chance that the Godora people would be more vigilant. After all, knowing that the other party was not a native but a wanderer from a high-leveled civilization, their mentality would be different. The success rate of a sneak attack would be lower.

Furthermore, the identity of an advanced civilization was not that useful. Godora was a Star System civilization and had seen the world. Why would they help him? Even if Han Xiao was willing to pay, Kerlodd could directly contact the Six Nations and did not lack resources. The other party might not even bother to help and ignore him.

In the worst case scenario, the Godora people would turn against him. A wanderer who could not contact the civilization behind him would be at the mercy of others.

With only a few seconds to think, Han Xiao decided to be a bandit. Not only that, he had a new plan. The first step was to capture Kerlodd and prevent him from contacting the Six Nations.

On the other side, Kerlodd slowly got up. He was not injured at all. The surface of his combat suit glowed with a golden light. This was the shield that came with the combat suit.

His expression was cold. He reached out and took off the two small golden balls that were tied to the ends of his braids. Mechanical Force flashed on his fingertips, and the small balls quickly expanded. They turned into a pale gold round shield and a dark gold long spear. They looked simple, but they gave off energy waves, indicating that they were not normal cold weapons.

"Native, you have made a big mistake."

Turning the small golden balls into equipment was a common technique used by Mechanics to compress equipment into small objects. Most advanced civilizations knew how to do it, but Godora's equipment was obviously more advanced.

Kerlodd was a LV 63 Mechanical Pugilist. Pure-blooded Godora people had racial advantages compared to normal humans. His attributes were not lower than Blue Star's LV 60 Pugilist. He also had a full set of advanced equipment. His combat power was around three thousand Ona, and he was a Grade C Super. Just from his combat power, he was stronger than all the LV 60 Supers in Blue Star.

However, he was not stronger than Han Xiao.

The battle started!

Han Xiao spread his wings, and the four machine guns on the aircraft opened fire. Kerlodd raised his shield, and an even bigger round light shield appeared on the surface of the shield.

Ding! Ding!

The bullets were all deflected by the light shield.

Kerlodd roared and pointed his spear at Han Xiao from afar. A series of cone-shaped golden light bullets shot out from the tip of the spear. Han Xiao jumped up, and the light bullets brushed past him, leaving behind melted holes in the trees along the way, disappearing into the horizon.

Godora's craftsmanship was a mix of technology and magic. This was not a purely technology-based energy weapon, but its power was still much higher than normal gunpowder weapons. One light bullet could take off five hundred of Amphiptere's Defense. The damage was very high.

Han Xiao flew up into the sky and used the Gauss sniper rifle to kite the enemy. However, the electromagnetic bullets were all blocked by the shield. Kerlodd took out another small golden ball, which turned into a strange gun half the size of a person. He fired a shot into the sky.

Boom!

A hot beam of light shot out, and Han Xiao quickly dodged it. Just the edge of the beam brushed past the mechanical suit, and his Defense was reduced by three hundred.

With advanced equipment, the advantage of being a Mechanic was immediately displayed. Kerlodd was supposed to be an enemy that could only be encountered in Version 2.0, so he naturally felt that the damage was too high.

Although investigators were not known for their combat abilities, Kerlodd was an exception. He was very confident in his own abilities. Just with the equipment provided by the Investigation Bureau, he could easily crush these low-level civilizations.

Kerlodd had a sense of superiority as an emissary of an advanced civilization, so he did not take the Blue Star natives seriously. He did not know why Han Xiao attacked him, but a native dared to provoke him, which was no different from asking for death. He wanted to make Han Xiao understand this.

Han Xiao was calm. It was not that he had never fought an enemy with better equipment. Although Kerlodd's equipment was good, and his attributes were not bad, he was just an elite. His skills and talents were very average.

This should be my first time fighting a Black Star Warrior. His long-range firepower is better than mine. Let's try close combat.

With a thought, Han Xiao dove down. Four Sonic Spheres flew out and bombarded Kerlodd with all kinds of sonic attacks. Kerlodd's combat suit's shield rippled, and the damage output was very stable.

Kerlodd swung his spear and counterattacked. Han Xiao also had the Hovering Shield Shuttles to form a basic shield and blocked the attack.

Hum!

The Electromagnetic Chain Blade cut through Kerlodd's shield like a butterfly cutting through flowers. Sparks flew everywhere.

Boom! Boom!

Boom! Powerful punches and kicks landed on Kerlodd's body. The shield was shaking, and the Amphiptere mechanical suit was also damaged.

Although close combat was the advantage of a Mechanical Pugilist, Han Xiao's skills and talents were constantly activated, so he was not weak at all.

The two of them fought fiercely, and the battlefield gradually moved away from the spaceship crash site. The forest around them was a mess.

Although the Godora Investigator had the advantage in terms of equipment and technology, Han Xiao had too many tricks up his sleeves. Kerlodd was starting to get tired of dealing with him.

Sonic Sphere – Pierce shot out another sonic wave. The shield flickered a few times before its energy was depleted and dimmed down.

He's too hard to deal with! Kerlodd felt that something was wrong. He made up his mind and used his shield to take the attack head-on. The shield was getting dimmer and dimmer. He took the opportunity to expand another golden sphere and turned it into a giant axe. This was the weapon with the most powerful one-shot damage among all of his weapons.

He decided to end this battle!

The axe flashed, and Kerlodd swung it down.

Boom!

The ground cracked, and a few cracks appeared on the armor. His Armor was depleted!

"Again!" Kerlodd roared and took a step back. His body flashed, and he obviously used a skill. He swung the axe right in front of Han Xiao's head!

A sense of danger appeared between Han Xiao's eyebrows. The air pressure from the axe quickly fell!

"Great!" Han Xiao was not shocked but overjoyed. He immediately activated the skill that he had been preparing for a long time.

[Recoil — Thorns]!

Dang!

The axe spun and flew away. Kerlodd fell to the ground with a thud. His hands were bleeding.

Han Xiao's max level [Recoil — Thorns] could reflect 50% of the melee damage. It broke through the shield and caused real damage.

The Sonic Sphere attacked again. Kerlodd was blown away, but his shield was still protecting him tenaciously.

"You're very strong. I didn't expect there to be such a strong person on this low-level planet!"

Kerlodd breathed heavily and got up. He took out another two golden spheres and turned them into a longsword and a new shield. He was full of fighting spirit.

"But choosing me as your opponent is your biggest mistake! My equipment is way better than yours. You're a strong warrior. I'll give you a warrior's death. "

Han Xiao stopped and shook his head.

"You're so hard to deal with. I didn't want to use this skill."

Before Kerlodd could react, he was shocked to see Han Xiao's energy level increase crazily. A thick blue electric current surrounded the mechanical suit like a lightning python. The mechanical suit's energy core emitted a blinding light.

At the same time, the shadow of a man wearing a black mask appeared behind him.

Mechanical Suit Skill [Snake — Devil]: Energy core overloaded, attributes doubled. All modules can be used at will. Duration: 2-7 minutes. Cooldown: 7 days.

Character Summon Card — Germinal Organization Leader [Armor Piercing Combo]: All attacks released in the next 8 seconds will be critical armor piercing, and the target's defense will be weakened by 24%. Duration: 5 minutes. Usage: 1/12]

Also, Burning Will! Overload! Mechanical Force surged!

Bang bang bang bang!
